issues.desc: CHK-002, CHK-003, and CHK-004 lack explicit userSees fields; the user-observable outcomes are implicit (ledger rows carry review-run identity; previously-invisible spawns appear in the ledger; guidance names the new command). Consider adding userSees for traceability, though this does not block INIT.

Background cites "B-fbb6 verified" for the claim that agy print mode surfaces no per-call usage, but B-fbb6's index.json phase is DISCARDED (not DONE) — the underlying verification in B-fbb6/background.md is specific and credible (agy --print stdout/--log-file probe), but a reader spot-checking the citation will see a discarded story and may question the claim's authority. Consider rephrasing to cite the verification finding directly (e.g. "verified via agy --print probe, see B-fbb6/background.md") rather than implying B-fbb6 itself completed.
